description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Oreskos Sun Guide to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide, targeting Oreskos Sun Guide.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
